verdict.rationale: MX provides webhooks that notify a developer's system of events (mx-docs-7, mx-docs-22, mx-docs-41) and a dashboard to create/test/delete webhooks, which is the event-detection half of the story, but there is no evidence of a built-in rules engine where users define conditional actions that MX itself executes automatically — the 'action' side is left entirely to the developer's own downstream system. Missing for 10: a native rule/condition builder, documented automatic action execution (e.g., trigger a payment, alert, or workflow) tied to events, and any example of an end-to-end automated rule.
